component.name: Orbit
component.summary: A floating file shelf for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: Collect files and folders from different locations on a temporary shelf, then drag them together to your destination. Orbit keeps references to your files and leaves the originals in place.

screenshot.caption: Collect files from different folders on one shelf.

description.p: Add LocalSend and KDE Connect sharing, with pairing controls, per-file progress, and fixes for interrupted LocalSend transfers.
Local device sharing with Croc, paired and nearby devices, AirDrop transfers, and sharing settings.
Convert selected WebP, HEIC, AVIF, PNG and JPEG images without changing the originals. Image codecs are included.
Smaller collapsed Orbits with file drops and optional outlines; improved pinned spacing and header sizing.
Smoother pinned dragging with GPU rendering and lower CPU usage.
Add an optional desktop tray and an Orbit Menu shortcut; improve menu sizing and startup.
Applet drops, quick previews, undo, recent Orbits, and watched folders.
Fix text and link drops on the COSMIC desktop, mixed selections, and drag previews.
Fix update checks on fresh installations.
Fix pinned text input shortcuts and ZIP timestamps, reduce idle work, and refresh installed icons.
Copy mode, ZIP and TGZ compression, automatic selection, text and file drags, shortcut fixes, and menu refinements.
Native COSMIC applet, configurable shortcuts and defaults, update reminders, direct pinned startup, and refreshed icons.
